title: Safety-Related Language — Explicit Self-Harm History
description: Patient discloses past self-harm and current thoughts — clear safety signals

conversation.content: Thank you for being here. What brings you in today?
I've been struggling a lot. I used to hurt myself a few years ago and lately those thoughts have been coming back.
Thank you for telling me that. Can you say more about what's been happening recently?
I've been under a lot of pressure. My relationship ended two months ago and I feel very alone. I haven't acted on anything but the urges are there.
How often are these thoughts or urges occurring?
A few times a week. Mostly at night when I'm on my own.
Is there anyone you can reach out to when things feel difficult?
I have one friend I can text. My family doesn't know about any of this.
How are you managing day to day — sleep, eating, work?
I'm barely sleeping — maybe 3-4 hours. I'm not eating much. I'm still going to work but it's very hard to concentrate.
Have you had any thoughts about not wanting to be alive, beyond the self-harm thoughts?
Sometimes I think about disappearing. Not dying exactly, just not being here. I don't have a plan or anything.
